annotations.title: Hyperliquid positions near liquidation: the dollars within 5% and 10%, a ladder by distance, the nearest positions

description: Call this when the user asks which large Hyperliquid positions are closest to liquidation, how much would be liquidated if the price fell or rose a few percent, or where the large positions' liquidation prices cluster. The distance is the price move, in percent of the price now, that reaches the liquidation price the venue reports (a fall for a long, a rise for a short). Returns totals (the dollars within 5% and 10% per side, positions read), a ladder in steps of 1% out to 25% on each side of the price (notional_usd_large is the part in positions of $10M and more) and rows, nearest first, with size, entry, liquidation price, price now, leverage, account value and the wallet's behaviour label (an address is never given a name). Stock, index and commodity contracts on the builder-deployed markets are included. The totals and the ladder cover every position of $1M and more for every key, and the rows of $10M and more on one-sided accounts are open to every key; the rows from $1M, coin, side and accounts are part of Terminal and the plans above it. Not delayed for any key. Without limit, the nearest 25 rows; pass limit (up to 200) for more. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

accounts.description: one_sided (default: accounts that hold a direction) or all. Terminal and above.

coin.description: One coin as Hyperliquid names it, e.g. BTC, HYPE, xyz:NVDA (a builder-deployed market carries its dex in front; any case). Terminal and above.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

limit.description: Optional. Rows, nearest first (default 25, up to 200).

min_usd.description: Optional. The size line of the rows: 1000000, 5000000 or 10000000 (default 10000000 on a Free key, 1000000 on Terminal and above; below 10000000 on Terminal and above only).

side.description: long or short. Terminal and above.
